list.caption: Drop links of the entity
list.empty: No drop link for this entity yet.
list.lastUsedNote: The last use is recorded at most once a minute: it can lag by up to a minute.
list.unusedHint: Consider disabling or revoking this link, or setting an expiry date.

label.label: Label
label.hint: Name of the service or collection, shown to depositors (at most 100 characters).

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.hint: Internal addresses that receive the deposited files, one per line (at most 20). They are never shown to depositors.

validity.hint: Applied to every deposit made through this link. The confidentiality level must allow it.

level.label: Confidentiality level
level.hint: Applied to every deposit made through this link.

enabled.label: Link enabled
enabled.hint: A disabled link refuses deposits; you can enable it again later.

expiry.label: Expiry date (optional)
expiry.hint: The link refuses deposits after the end of this day (your local time). Leave empty for no end.

cap.label: Deposits per hour
cap.hint: Transfers accepted through this link per hour, all depositors together (1 to {max}). Beyond it, deposits are refused for a while.

edit.title: Edit the link {label}
edit.intro: The address of the link does not change. To replace it, use "Rotate".
edit.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving them?

levelsError: The confidentiality levels could not be loaded: the level names are shown as keys and the level choice may be incomplete. Reload the page to try again.

rotate.title: Rotate the link {label}?
rotate.text: A new address is created and the old one stops working at once: people who saved it will no longer be able to deposit. The new address is shown only once.

revoke.title: Revoke the link {label}?
revoke.text: The link stops working for good. This cannot be undone: to receive deposits again, create a new link.

secret.title: Drop link {label}
secret.text: This is the address of the drop link. Copy it now and give it to the people who must send files: it will never be shown again.
secret.rotatedText: This is the new address of the link. The old one no longer works. Copy it now: it will never be shown again.
secret.label: Drop link address

errors.labelTooLong: The label must not exceed {max} characters.
errors.limit: The maximum number of drop links is reached. Revoke an unused link and try again.
errors.conflict: This link is revoked: it can no longer be changed. Reload the page.
errors.notFound: This link no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.expiryPast: Choose a date in the future.
errors.capInvalid: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
